title: Doha City Tour with Villaggio Mall & Gondola Ride
imageAlt: Gondola ride through the Venetian canals of Villaggio Mall
summary: Souq Waqif, the Corniche, The Pearl and Lusail, then a gondola through the indoor canals of Villaggio Mall — half a day, door to door.
overview: Half a day is enough to meet Doha properly when someone else does the driving. You are collected from your hotel lobby, the airport arrivals gate or the cruise terminal and travel in an air-conditioned vehicle with an English-speaking guide. The route runs through the city in one loop: the spice stalls and falcon souq of Souq Waqif, a Corniche photo stop under the West Bay towers, the yacht marinas and Venice-style Qanat Quartier at The Pearl, and the Katara Towers and promenades of Lusail. The finish is deliberately different: inside Villaggio Mall, a gondola glides along an indoor Venetian canal, included in your tour. Choose shared or private, and we drop you back where you began.
bestFor: Families, first-time visitors and mall-and-city days in one
highlights: Gondola ride along the Villaggio Mall canal — ticket included
Souq Waqif spice stalls, handicrafts and the falcon souq
The Pearl marinas and Lusail waterfront photo stops
Hotel, airport or cruise-terminal pickup and drop-off

itinerary.title: Pickup at your door
itinerary.description: Collected from your Doha hotel lobby, airport arrivals gate 4 or Cruise Terminal 1, and set off in an air-conditioned vehicle with your guide.

itinerary.title: Souq Waqif
itinerary.description: About 45 minutes in the restored market lanes — spice stalls, perfumes, handicrafts and the falcon souq set in traditional Qatari architecture.

itinerary.title: Doha Corniche photo stop
itinerary.description: Around a 20-minute pause on the waterfront for the sweep of the bay and the West Bay skyline across the water.

itinerary.title: The Pearl-Qatar
itinerary.description: Roughly 40 minutes among the marinas and yachts, with time to walk the Venice-style canals of the Qanat Quartier.

itinerary.title: Lusail
itinerary.description: About 50 minutes for the Katara Towers, the waterfront promenades and a photo stop in the Lusail Stadium area.

itinerary.title: Villaggio Mall gondola ride
itinerary.description: End inside the mall, where Italian-style indoor streets run beneath a painted sky — your included gondola ticket covers the drift along the Venetian canal before drop-off.

included: Pickup and drop-off — hotel, Hamad International Airport or Doha Cruise Terminal
excluded: Meals and drinks beyond bottled water
notes: Plan for four to five hours door to door; the stop order can shift with traffic, weather and mall opening hours, though the gondola ride always closes the route.
Souq Waqif, The Pearl and Lusail all involve walking outdoors, so comfortable shoes and sun protection matter most between May and September.
Mall opening hours do not affect morning departures, but if your tour runs late in the day the gondola can pause briefly for shops to open.
Cancellations are accepted up to 24 hours before departure.
Tell us your pickup point — hotel, airport or cruise terminal — when you enquire, and we confirm the exact window for your date.

faqs.question: How long does the tour take and when does it start?
faqs.answer: Plan for four to five hours door to door. Your exact pickup time is confirmed when you book, based on your location and the season.

faqs.question: Can you pick me up from the airport or cruise port?
faqs.answer: Yes. Collection is offered from your Doha hotel lobby, Hamad International Airport arrivals gate 4 or Doha Cruise Terminal 1, and the drop-off returns you to the hotel, the airport or the port — whichever suits your plans.

faqs.question: Is the gondola ride really included?
faqs.answer: Yes. The gondola ticket along the indoor canal at Villaggio Mall is part of the tour, and it is the final stop before drop-off. Nothing extra is needed at the mall.

faqs.question: Is this a private tour or a shared group departure?
faqs.answer: Both run. A shared booking joins other travellers in the vehicle, while the private option gives your group its own vehicle and guide for the whole route.

faqs.question: How much walking is involved?
faqs.answer: The souq, The Pearl and Lusail are walking stops, taken at a pace that suits your group, while the Corniche is a short photo stop and the mall is level and air-conditioned. Comfortable shoes are enough for the whole route.

faqs.question: Can children join?
faqs.answer: Yes — the route is easy with children throughout, and the gondola is a calm ride inside the mall that younger guests usually enjoy most. Mention your group when you enquire so the seating works.

sampleReviews.name: M. Reyes
sampleReviews.title: A little bit of everything
sampleReviews.text: Falcon souq in the morning, skyline photos on the Corniche and then a gondola inside a mall — our kids could not pick a favourite. The guide kept the whole afternoon moving without ever rushing us.

sampleReviews.name: J. Whitfield
sampleReviews.title: Smart way to end a city tour
sampleReviews.text: Villaggio might be the strangest, most delightful finish to any city tour we have done — painted skies inside. Pickup at gate 4 was exactly on time and the car was spotless.
